mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park under a third quarter moon.

The Verona Senior Center is currently highlighting their tri-shaw bike program which provides free 30-minute rides for seniors. Also, the Recreation Department is hiring for various seasonal roles, so check their website if you are looking to join their team.

Today is packed with activities including the downtown farmer's market, trivia at The Bogey Factory, pizza at the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and music at Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and trivia at Hop Haus.
In a notable call from July 31st, an officer performed a traffic stop that resulted in an arrest for O W I and citations for suspended registration.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open at 10 AM.
